desc: The Scythe-Ti is SilencerCo’s first suppressor completely constructed from titanium. This premium .30 caliber silencer is extremely lightweight and short, while still boasting impressive sound suppression. It’s the optimal choice for suppressed hunting, long-range precision shooting or days at the range. The Scythe-Ti is a .30 caliber suppressor, handling calibers ranging from .223 REM/5.56 NATO all the way up to .300 RUM. It’s intended for bolt-guns and semi-automatic rifles with the added bonus of no barrel length restrictions.
